mapper.select: SELECT od.id AS orderDetailId, od.`type`, od.billing_item_id AS billingItemId, od.price, od.quantity, od.receivable_amount AS receivableAmount, od.receivable_amount AS actualAmount, ifnull( odpr.received_amount, 0 ) AS receivedAmount, 100 AS discountRate, od.tooth_bit AS toothBit, od.executor_id AS executorId, od.source_type AS sourceType, od.remarks FROM order_detail od LEFT JOIN ( SELECT odpr.order_detail_id, odpr.received_amount FROM order_detail_pay_record odpr WHERE odpr.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId} ) odpr ON od.id = odpr.order_detail_id WHERE od.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId}

select a.*, case a.type when 0 then bt.name when 1 then bot.name end as name, case a.type when 0 then bt.english_name when 1 then bot.english_name end as english_name from ( SELECT br.received_amount AS totalReceivedAmount, br.receivable_amount AS totalReceivableAmount, br.privilege_amount AS totalPrivilegeAmount, br.actual_receivable_amount AS totalActualReceivableAmount, br.debt_amount AS totalDebtAmount, date_format(br.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as crt_time, br.invoice_number, od.tooth_bit, od.type, od.billing_item_id, od.quantity, od.price, od.order_record_id, od.id, odpr.receivable_amount, odpr.privilege_amount, odpr.actual_receivable, odpr.received_amount FROM bill_record br LEFT JOIN order_detail od ON od.treatment_record_id = br.treatment_record_id AND od.order_record_id = br.order_record_id LEFT JOIN order_detail_pay_record odpr ON odpr.inservice = 1 and odpr.treatment_record_id = br.treatment_record_id and odpr.order_record_id = br.order_record_id and odpr.order_detail_id = od.id and odpr.bill_record_id = br.id WHERE br.patient_id = #{patientId} and br.bill_number=#{billNumber}) a LEFT JOIN base_tariff bt on bt.id = a.billing_item_id LEFT JOIN base_oral_tariff bot on bot.id = a.billing_item_id
